title: Enterprise Presentation Processing Platform
summary: Backend for uploading, processing and co-editing large corporate slide decks for a global financial-services client.
problem: Heavy PowerPoint processing blocked user requests, parallel editors overwrote each other, and database schemas drifted between environments.
solution: C#/ASP.NET Core features with EF Core/MySQL; long-running document work moved to background jobs and queues; PowerPoint document integration; SignalR-based edit locking; roles, permissions and email workflows.
result: Processing no longer blocks users, concurrent editing is coordinated in real time, and migrations stay consistent across environments.
